title: 5-minute pitch video script and recording
context: Video is the most-weighted artifact per the application form (last question read first, per Razorpay's own framing).
objective: Script and record a 5-minute pitch covering: the problem, why ACP specifically, architecture walkthrough, live demo including the deliberate rejection case, and the 'what broke' story.
scope_in: Script beats: 0:00-0:45 problem + why ACP, 0:45-2:00 architecture walkthrough (use docs/architecture.md), 2:00-4:00 live demo (happy path + the T7.1 rejection scenario), 4:00-4:45 what broke and how you fixed it, 4:45-5:00 close
Record against the deployed public URLs, not localhost, to prove it's real
scope_out: Do not exceed 5 minutes — cut ruthlessly rather than rush
acceptance_criteria: Live demo section shows the actual rejection case running, not just described
No claim in the video is unverifiable — nothing fabricated about metrics or results
